تذبذبت (form IIq)
# تَذَبْذَبْتُ (taḏabḏabtu) /ta.ðab.ðab.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَذَبْذَبَ (taḏabḏaba)
# تَذَبْذَبْتَ (taḏabḏabta) /ta.ðab.ðab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَذَبْذَبَ (taḏabḏaba)
# تَذَبْذَبْتِ (taḏabḏabti) /ta.ðab.ðab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَذَبْذَبَ (taḏabḏaba)
# تَذَبْذَبَتْ (taḏabḏabat) /ta.ðab.ða.bat/: t
